name: application-feature-highlight-row
title: Feature Highlight Row
description: Stacked icon + title + description feature blocks, each icon in its own tinted color square.
useWhen: Listing a small set of product features or benefits with an icon, short title, and one to two sentences of description.
You want each feature's icon to carry its own distinct accent color for visual variety without full illustrations.
The list reads top-to-bottom as a stack, not side-by-side cards or a grid.
avoidWhen: You're listing playable media or navigable list items, not static feature descriptions — use `media-object-row` for that unrelated, interactive pattern.
You need a card-grid layout instead of a vertical stack — this component doesn't wrap into columns on its own.
There are more than 4-5 features — a stacked list that long should be paginated, tabbed, or split into sections instead.
responsiveBehavior: Single-column stack at a fixed max width; icon squares stay a fixed size while title/description text wraps naturally within the remaining width.
accessibility: Each feature title is a real heading (<h3>), giving the block a navigable outline for screen reader users rather than styled paragraph text.
Icons are aria-hidden since the adjacent heading already names the feature; the icon is a visual accelerator, not the sole identifier.
Each icon's tint color is decorative variety only — no meaning is encoded in which color a given feature gets, so color choice never needs to be memorized to understand the content.

variants.title: Feature Highlight Row
variants.description: Three features (Bank-grade encryption, Instant transfers, Works everywhere) each with a distinct icon tint.
accessibility: Icon tint colors are purely decorative and never the sole means of distinguishing one feature from another — titles and descriptions carry the actual meaning.

variants.title: Feature Highlight Row (Dark)
variants.description: Feature highlight row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Icon tint squares use low-opacity backgrounds with -400 icon strokes to hold WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
